metric_interaction_finding.core_tension: Episode Recall credits ANY detection (Warning or Critical) across the entire 30-minute pre-failure horizon. Conversely, Gate 1 Critical Recall evaluates ONLY whether window-level class 2 predictions match true class 2 windows (TTF <= 15m). Because accurate early alerts predict Warning during 15m < TTF <= 30m, and neural networks calibrated with cross-entropy often output Warning rather than Critical in the final 15 minutes, Episode Recall can be high (60-70%) while Critical Recall remains near zero (2.0%).
